source_dataset: processed_dataset_v1_wide.csv (157 subjects: CN 100 / MCI 41 / AD 16; same subject set as processed_dataset_v2_long.csv)
method: heldout AD: random.Random(seed).sample of the 16 AD subjects. CV folds: stratified by group; within-group seeded shuffle then round-robin assignment to folds 1..4 (same method as subject-level run_baselines.stratified_folds).
heldout_ad_role: excluded from every training fold; appended to every validation fold
validation_rule: validation(f) = subjects of fold f + the 4 held-out AD subjects
caveats: The same 4 held-out AD subjects appear in every validation fold, so validation folds are not independent and pooled CV metrics overweight these 4 subjects.
The 4 held-out AD subjects are never seen in training, so the model does not learn from them.
Report per-fold metrics separately and do not treat the pooled CV mean as an unbiased generalization estimate. Reporting the 4 held-out AD separately is optional.
